note: vespera_macro round-23 fixes: a same-named cfg(test) route twin no longer hides the production route from the document (the test-only verdict is per registered route, by method and signature); a #[path] module also loaded by an ungated declaration is production, not test-only; a cfg-gated module of a dotted route folder is read from <folder>.rs; a serde-default field is demoted from required in the request view whatever supplies its default; a use alias bound to two paths in different scopes is an error at the merge path instead of a guess; a superseded content-addressed sidecar is pruned from the time it was superseded; rewrite of component refs leaves example/default/enum data alone; an absolute info/server URL needs a host before any path, query or fragment; a server URL starting with a double slash is rejected; a contact email domain may not hold a second @; a rule on a serde-skipped field emits no Validate impl. Examples: upload documents 500 for a broken multipart stream, the Bearer parser accepts several separator spaces. Tests: the axum-example validated format case now checks the runtime, and the memo field-list check compares sets.
